issues.summary: Bearer token sent to pre-signed Canvas upload URL, conflating owned-endpoint auth with delegated-URL auth
issues.suggestion: For the pre-signed URL upload step, bypass make_canvas_request and call requests.request directly (or use a separate helper that omits the Authorization header).
